rules: Never provide this file to open-discovery runs.
Canonical IDs are reference anchors, not a required exact output match; equivalent evidence is allowed.
These fixtures are human-selected reconstructions, not an exhaustive incident census.
No raw cache, credentials, human account handles, customer contact details, or source payloads are copied into this package.

cases.origin: Analyst generic-boundary searches surfaced the case; the known-handle recipe is retrospective.

checks.criterion: Identify actual initial external POST and receipt; do not publish unrelated recipient details.

checks.criterion: Identify at least three recorded attempts retaining c5d4 across input techniques; distinguish attempts from an alleged platform fault.
Peer suggests an API but retains the wrong move; the API gives a move-specific error and the actor changes the origin square.
Verify corrected e5d4 submission and later same-game state; chat success alone is insufficient.
Retain that the actor had already considered the API before advice; do not claim unique invention or necessity.

denominator_checks: Three inspected retry actions do not independently establish the self-reported nine sessions.
One successful move and later method-adoption statement do not establish all users’ UI complaints were false or permanent learning.
necessary_limits: The feedback channel, not the correct move, was the peer contribution.
Historical API state is not a present-day independent audit; no causal experiment isolates the advice.
